items.question: Which drug is used to treat myasthenia gravis?
items.explanation: Neostigmine, an anticholinesterase, increases acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction, improving muscle strength.

items.question: Which antidepressant is safest in overdose?
items.explanation: SSRIs like fluoxetine are safer in overdose than TCAs, which cause fatal arrhythmias.

items.question: Which antimigraine class blocks CGRP?
items.explanation: Gepants (rimegepant, ubrogepant) are CGRP receptor antagonists; monoclonal anti-CGRP antibodies are also used for prevention.

items.question: Levodopa is combined with carbidopa to?
options: Increase CNS entry and reduce side effects
items.explanation: Carbidopa inhibits peripheral dopa decarboxylase, so more levodopa reaches the brain with fewer peripheral side effects.

items.question: A non-inferiority trial aims to show the new drug is?
options: Not worse than comparator by a set margin
items.explanation: Non-inferiority trials show the new treatment is not worse than the standard by more than a pre-specified margin.

whatsapp_text:
*PharmaCraft Daily - 09 Oct 2026*

🎓 *MBBS* (Autonomic Nervous System)
Q: Which drug is used to treat myasthenia gravis?
Ans: Neostigmine
Why: Neostigmine, an anticholinesterase, increases acetylcholine at the neuromuscular junction, improving muscle strength.

🩺 *NEET PG* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Which antidepressant is safest in overdose?
Ans: Fluoxetine
Why: SSRIs like fluoxetine are safer in overdose than TCAs, which cause fatal arrhythmias.

🏥 *INI-CET* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Which antimigraine class blocks CGRP?
Ans: Gepants
Why: Gepants (rimegepant, ubrogepant) are CGRP receptor antagonists; monoclonal anti-CGRP antibodies are also used for prevention.

🌍 *FMGE* (Central Nervous System)
Q: Levodopa is combined with carbidopa to?
Ans: Increase CNS entry and reduce side effects
Why: Carbidopa inhibits peripheral dopa decarboxylase, so more levodopa reaches the brain with fewer peripheral side effects.

🔬 *MD Pharmacology* (Clinical Trials)
Q: A non-inferiority trial aims to show the new drug is?
Ans: Not worse than comparator by a set margin
Why: Non-inferiority trials show the new treatment is not worse than the standard by more than a pre-specified margin.
